primary_behavior: Transform one owner-selected source record into a deterministic governed ontology package and provide fail-closed validation, list/get retrieval, and a generated human projection.
acceptance_criteria: Equal source bytes build byte-identical ontology packages.
The package validates against its closed schema and Rust semantic checks.
Duplicate nodes, dangling relations, and non-none authority effects fail closed.
List and get retrieve only declared nodes; unknown identities fail closed.
Human views are generated and byte-current with their machine records.
Product, Product Ontology, package output, Craft, contexts, and runtime identities do not collapse.
approval_boundary: Product testing precedes one separate Product approval decision bound to the immutable candidate and product-test receipt digests.
claim_ceiling: Ready for private Product testing only. This manifest does not itself prove tests pass, approve the Product, admit artifacts or contexts, adopt the runtime, publish, release, deploy, or retire source material.
